title: Cards Extraction: Water Rush
description: Fork of Simple Triggers turned into a push-your-luck expedition. Stake water, auto-walk the desert and watch your water graph rise and fall like a stock. Robber battles come faster the more water you carry (every 30s down to 10s), plus treasure chests and water spikes that come more often the more water you set out with. Reach 5x your stake (or lose a battle) and the caravan's morale breaks: from there it's all downhill to a quarter of your stake. Cash out in time. Characters are Helpers, Attackers or Summoners with team synergies.
